name: Coderaalok
title: the missing diamond
briefing: A priceless diamond vanished during a charity gala with no signs of forced entry.

suspects.name: Arthur Vance
suspects.alibi: Wine cellar from 11:15 to 11:55 PM selecting vintage wines.
suspects.motive: Severe gambling debts to underground creditors.

1:
Arthur: 'I was down in the private wine cellar inventorying bottles.
 The cellar door is heavy oak and soundproof, Detective. I heard nothing.'
2: Ask about relationship with Lord Blackwood

Arthur: 'I have served the Blackwood family loyally for fifteen years.
 His lordship pays me handsomely. Why would I jeopardize my position?'
3: Confront with Crumpled East Exit Note

Arthur: *hesitates and turns pale*
 'T-that note... Alright, I admit it! I was meeting a loan shark at the east exit
 to beg for more time on my debts. But when I got there, someone ran past me toward
 the gardens in a guard uniform! I swear I did NOT touch the diamond!'

suspects.name: Evelyn Reed
suspects.alibi: Private phone call on dining balcony with champagne guests.
suspects.motive: Facing bankruptcy after a failed luxury jewelry venture.
suspects.contradiction_clue: Wine glass with lipstick at seat 4

1:
Evelyn: 'I was on the terrace on a call with our pastry supplier until midnight.
 Several prestigious donors saw me there and can vouch for me.'
2: Ask about access to the exhibition hall

Evelyn: 'As the event planner, I had the schedule, but only authorized security
 guards had keycards to the diamond display case.'
3: Confront with Wine Glass & Lipstick Mark

Evelyn: 'Yes, that is my shade of lipstick at table 4. I took two sips of champagne
 before heading out to take my call. Check with the guests—I never went near the gallery!'

suspects.name: Thomas Blackwood
suspects.alibi: Claims he had a migraine and left the mansion before 11:00 PM.
suspects.motive: Disinherited playboy facing immense debts; size 10 boot wearer.

1:
Thomas: 'I told you already, Detective! My head was throbbing, so I hailed an Uber
 and left before 11:00 PM. I wasn't even in the mansion when the diamond vanished.'
2: Ask about his disinheritance by Lord Blackwood

Thomas: *scoffs bitterly*
 'My uncle is a greedy old hypocrite. Cut me off because I wouldn't work at his firm.
 But stealing? That's ridiculous. I have standards.'
3: Confront with Muddy Size 10 Footprint & Security Log

Thomas: *eyes widen in panic*
 'Muddy boots?! Keycard #7?! That—that's circumstantial garbage!
 Anyone could wear size 10 boots! You have no proof it was me!'
